scope.capture: Core/environment: padded data-visual-frame with track/thumb, label, disabled-selected comparison and output/error text. Zoom: complete current visible1264x805 physical viewport,632x402CSS viewport, not full-page. Inventory:1280x720 default viewport.

conclusions: All94 new PNGs were individually opened at original detail, including repeated hashes. Old failed screenshots were never used as a substitute.
Three declared sizes and both modes keep intact track/thumb geometry, circle state layers, exterior focus contours, error outlines/fills and readable nearby error explanations.
Material size specification explicitly keeps small28x16 and medium/large52x32. The public large configuration sharing medium track dimensions is documented and not a missing-size failure.
All six disabled-selected pictures retain the right-side selected thumb and show 当前选择:on. Unchecked pictures show off; RTL reverses thumb travel without losing the selected/on correspondence.
Actual mouse-down frames preserve the expected thumb/state-layer changes. Keyboard focus exterior outlines and legal MD3 halo are fully included by the sampled frame.
320px and English long labels wrap completely; track/thumb do not cover text. Brand, system forced-colors and reduced-motion remain limited to their sampled environment.

The new environment/zoom native checks measure actual browser track/thumb/pseudo-element boxes and real hit edges; actual edge interactions toggle off/on with matching output. Pixel review observes appearance separately and does not claim to measure48px by eye.

Two real200% PNGs retain track/thumb, state layer, exterior focus contour, full long label, disabled comparison andon output inside the current visible viewport. CSS zoom remains1 while chrome.tabs.setZoom=2; not DPR/viewport substitution.

The native artifact fingerprint is identical to the old failure candidate, while package geometry/env/zoom test sources changed. This new passing visual/interaction evidence is recorded independently; the old35fail+1interrupt findings remain unchanged.
No new visible geometry, clipping or feedback defect was found within this Windows Chromium MD3 scope.

candidateComparison.note: The Switch package has three changed test/helper sources. Seven additional global engineering/documentation source entries changed too; this review does not claim only three changes across the whole repository. Product artifact identity is independently bound.

evidence.overallNativeCoreMatrix: 216/216 across three designs; this manual review only MD3 72/72 images
evidence.overallNativeEnvironment: 60/60 across three designs, including6 realzoom; this manual review only MD3 20/20 images including2zoom

limitations: Only MD3 Windows Chromium images are manually reviewed here; Apple/shadcn, Linux canonical pixels, Firefox/WebKit and full-library completion remain separate.
The two default inventory images do not extend state/size acceptance. The no-PNG configuration-preservation boundary is native engineering evidence, not a manually viewed image.
Videos were not reviewed; a pressed/reduced-motion PNG does not prove transition timing or continuous motion advancement.
Standalone collection density beyond standard is documented not applicable; no loading/mixed protocol exists for Switch. Unlisted state combinations are not visually approved by this record.
No new capture, build or source/test/product edit was performed. Only new review files were written.
No canonical baseline, verified coverage or lifecycle was established; all previous failed originals/reviews remain unchanged.
